title: Switzerland marks day of mourning for victims of Crans-Montana fire tragedy
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron joins his Swiss and Italian counterparts in the town of Martigny for a memorial ceremony on Friday as Switzerland marks a day of national mourning for the dozens of victims, most of them teenagers, of the devastating New Year bar blaze in Crans-Montana. Watch the ceremony live on FRANCE 24 from 1:45pm local time (GMT+1).
